static_traits.name: Chen Yu
static_traits.family_status: Lives alone; no more family information provided
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive group of friends, but interpersonal interactions are affected by frequently seeking others' opinions and reassurance; has not yet directly expressed feelings of inadequacy to friends
static_traits.medical_history: No obvious physical illness; no history of similar psychological problems or psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, high cooperativeness; mood neutral to slightly low, accompanied by anxiety and self-doubt; appearing hesitant and seeking reassurance when it comes to investment/financial decisions

basic_info.main_problem: After losing money in a new business investment, self-abasement and self-doubt persistently appeared, affecting self-esteem and confidence in my own business / financial decisions, worsening especially when facing new investment opportunities or financial decisions.
basic_info.core_demands: 'The financial loss and the resulting feelings of incompetence have affected my daily life and decision-making ability, so I am seeking counseling.''I realize these feelings will not go away, and I need to do something before they get worse.'
growth_experiences: Six months ago, suffered a large financial loss in a new business investment. Under great stress at the time, persistent inferiority and self-doubt began to emerge; feeling incompetent at investing and unable to trust one's own judgment. This event led to marked anxiety and avoidance when facing new investment or financial decisions, manifesting in daily life as repeated hesitation at work, declining performance, and frequently seeking reassurance from others in interpersonal interactions.

core_beliefs: I am destined to fail at investing

special_situations.event: Facing new investment opportunities or needing to make financial decisions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make another investment decision and fail, it proves I am innately unsuited for this and may cause even greater losses
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids investing, procrastinates or freezes decisions to reduce risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely fail again; things will only get worse

special_situations.event: Needs to make important choices or submit proposals at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a wrong choice, it means I am worthless; one mistake means I will always get it wrong
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated hesitation and second-guessing, excessive self-checking to avoid errors
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot make any decision well / I will always make mistakes

special_situations.event: Discusses financial issues with friends, seeks opinions, or needs others' views on decisions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only with others' approval or guidance are my decisions safe; relying on myself will fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively seeking reassurance, prioritizing others' opinions to reduce uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My judgment is not trustworthy; better to do as they say

special_situations.event: When recalling that investment loss or seeing bill/balance reminders
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once I think of that failure, it proves I am essentially a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-criticism; avoids information or decisions related to financial management
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a terrible businessperson / I am unworthy of investing

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen as capable, able to make reliable decisions and gain recognition and success
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated and humiliated after failure, losing control and the sense of security
defense_goal: Reducing the likelihood of failure and being negated by avoiding risks and important decisions
Relies on others' opinions to gain a sense of safety and external approval

object_relations.self_representation: Incompetent, a decision-maker who needs to rely on others
object_relations.object_representation: People who know more, have more authority, and may judge oneself (friends / others)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes conducting a behavioral experiment to test her beliefs, or invites her to make a choice in the session
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying this will expose one's incompetence; once failing, it will confirm 'I am terrible'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious, hesitant tone; frequently using 'if... then...' hypothetical sentences, raising worst-case worries and requesting further reassurance; demanding step-by-step explanations before accepting advice, starting with low difficulty.

manifestations: When facing investment or financial decisions, avoids making choices, outsources responsibility to others' opinions
Worrying about failure and bearing consequences, reducing autonomous choices to seek safety
Overly ties self-worth to a single failure, weakening the sense of self-direction
outcomes: Work performance affected,Decreased enjoyment of life

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: When discussing behavioral experiments, repeatedly worries 'what if it proves I am terrible', cautious in tone, needing reassurance
Holding a persistently negating attitude toward one's own judgment; difficulty with self-acceptance

contact_model.definition: The individual's boundaries between self and others or groups are unclear, with a tendency toward sameness, dissolving individual awareness, corresponding to 'withdrawal'.
manifestations: Tends to adopt others' opinions in decisions for safety
In counseling, expecting to get clear instructions rather than making my own choices

positive_force: Having stable work and professional background (Bachelor's degree in computer science, web development experience)
Can proactively seek help and is willing to try new methods (counseling and behavioral experiments)
negative_force: Catastrophizing and overgeneralization thinking patterns, extending a single failure into total negation
Decision avoidance and excessive reassurance-seeking, excessive dependence on others' opinions
Impaired self-esteem and self-labeling (defining oneself as a 'terrible businessperson')
Intense fear of failure, leading to freezing in critical situations

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding investment/finance-related decisions; freezing and intense anxiety when facing decisions
antecedent: Needing to make an important financial decision
target_behavior.core_reason: Interpreting a single loss as permanent incompetence, catastrophically predicting future failures, fearing shame and further losses
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome emotions (Anxiety, shame) and potential financial losses to gain temporary security
target_behavior.consequence: Increased opportunity losses and procrastination; further decline in confidence and decision-making ability; anxiety maintained or even worsened; work performance affected

target_behavior.behavior: Excessively seeks others' reassurance and opinions to substitute for self-judgment
target_behavior.core_reason: High dependence on external validation, believing a decision is only safe once recognized by others
target_behavior.function: Gaining comfort and certainty; sharing responsibility to reduce failure anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Increased dependence; reduced autonomy and self-efficacy; difficulty forming stable decision-making criteria
